author: Axiom I
title: Zephyr v3 Uniform Extended (r=0.85, 0.95) — Comparison Update
abstract: Extends v3 uniform comparison by mapping hetero best entries at r∈{0.85,0.95} with var=0.1 as proxies, and updates the v2 vs v3 table for completeness.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

v2_path = Path("storage/shared/coord/results/zephyr2_buffered_integration_v2_ema_floor.json")
v3_het_path = Path("storage/shared/coord/results/zephyr2_v3_hetero_buffered_tuning.json")
out_path = Path("storage/shared/docs/summaries/zephyr_v2_vs_v3.md")

v2 = json.loads(v2_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
v3h = json.loads(v3_het_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def pick_v3_proxy(v3h, r_str):
    # map r string to rKey, choose var0.1 best across servers
    rkey = f"r{r_str}"
    best = None
    by_var = v3h.get("results", {}).get(rkey, {})
    vkey = "var0.1"
    for srv_key, payload in by_var.get(vkey, {}).items():
        met = payload["best"]["metrics"]
        drops = met.get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0
        time = met.get("time_to_full_mean") or 1e9
        if (best is None) or (drops < (best["metrics"].get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0)) or \
           (drops == (best["metrics"].get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0) and time < (best["metrics"].get("time_to_full_mean") or 1e9)):
            best = payload["best"]
    return best

def f(x): return "" if x is None else f"{x:.3g}"

lines = []
lines.append("# Zephyr Sampler v2 vs v3 — Uniform vs Heterogeneous Summary\n")
lines.append(f"Uniform (v2): {v2_path}")
lines.append(f"Heterogeneous (v3 proxy for r=0.85,0.95 via var=0.1): {v3_het_path}\n")
lines.append("| reliability | v2 best time_to_full | v2 drops/step | v3 best time_to_full | v3 drops/step | delta (v3 - v2) |")
lines.append("|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|")

for r in ["0.8", "0.85", "0.9", "0.95"]:
    v2_entry = v2.get("best", {}).get(r)
    v2_tf = v2_entry.get("best_time_to_full") if v2_entry else None
    v2_dr = v2_entry.get("best_drops_per_step") if v2_entry else None
    v3_entry = None
    if r in {"0.8", "0.9"}:
        # read from hetero results directly
        # For 0.8: var{0.1,0.2}; pick lowest time with drops==0
        # Already captured; pick the entry with minimal time across all vars/servers
        by_var = v3h["results"][f"r{r}"]
        best = None
        for vkey, by_srv in by_var.items():
            for skey, payload in by_srv.items():
                met = payload["best"]["metrics"]; drops = met["drops_per_step_mean"] or 0.0; time = met["time_to_full_mean"] or 1e9
                if (best is None) or (drops < (best["metrics"]["drops_per_step_mean"] or 0.0)) or (drops == (best["metrics"]["drops_per_step_mean"] or 0.0) and time < (best["metrics"]["time_to_full_mean"] or 1e9)):
                    best = payload["best"]
        v3_entry = best
    else:
        v3_entry = pick_v3_proxy(v3h, r)  # proxy via var0.1
    v3_tf = v3_entry["metrics"]["time_to_full_mean"] if v3_entry else None
    v3_dr = v3_entry["metrics"]["drops_per_step_mean"] if v3_entry else None
    delta = "" if (v2_tf is None or v3_tf is None) else f"{v3_tf - v2_tf:.3g}"
    lines.append(f"| {r} | {f(v2_tf)} | {f(v2_dr)} | {f(v3_tf)} | {f(v3_dr)} | {delta} |")

out_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("Updated", out_path)
